desc: 长柄夹口不粘手拾便器，薄荷几何详情页十一镜
leaf: 宠物长柄夹口拾便器（硬质杆身+弹簧咬口，双色两长档）
name: 长柄不粘手宠物拾便器款

shots.intent: 首屏用清爽几何展台把长柄拾便器整支立起来，一秒建立品类与形态认知
shots.textZone: 顶部居中主标题带与一行英文 kicker，其下一枚胶囊双词副标签位

shots.intent: 白底主图承担平台搜索位，纯静物把轮廓与夹口结构交代干净
把绕开捡便的三种日常尴尬拆成三张卡，制造代入感再引出解法
shots.textZone: 顶部居中问句式主标题带与胶囊副标签，三卡下方各一枚短标签位

shots.intent: 实地低角度作业画面证明长柄真的够得到、手真的不用靠近
用引线把握把、弹簧与咬口三段结构点名，解释为什么好发力
shots.textZone: 左侧三枚胶囊标签各配一行短说明位，引线端点落在结构处

shots.intent: 微距把咬口齿纹与双弹簧做实，用可见做工替代口头质量承诺
四格俯视步骤把用法讲透，消除买回去不会用的疑虑
shots.textZone: 顶部居中主标题带与胶囊副标题，四枚圆框下方各一行编号短标签位

shots.intent: 规格表一次交代尺寸与材质疑虑，替买家省掉追问客服
shots.textZone: 右栏六行标签与占位值，行距均匀，hairline 分隔线 #93AFA9，顶部一行主标题带

shots.intent: 把可选配色与杆长并列摆出，让买家一步选定不下单流失
shots.textZone: 每杆底端一枚配色与规格短标签位，顶部居中一行 kicker

shots.intent: 整支与随附实物平铺交代到手内容，用可见实物降低决策风险
shots.textZone: 顶部一行主标题带与一行 kicker，平铺物下方一行短标数位

shots.intent: 收口用近景与一个动作按钮把清洁痛点转成下单，低摩擦结束长图
shots.textZone: 上半区主标题带与一行副标题，右下圆角按钮位

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh minimal pet-care cleaning-tool ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page image set; fixed palette of mint panel #CFE3DA, deep sage panel #93AFA9, clean white #FFFFFF sweep and one deep-green capsule accent #4E8D7C with charcoal text #3A3A3A over a blush ground plane #F0D7D5; cool fresh tone; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline weight per screen and capsule sub-badges; background system of flat mint and deep sage panels joined by one soft curved wave divider; bright soft studio key from the front-left at 5500K with bounce fill, gentle falloff and soft contact shadows only, natural low sun at 5000K in outdoor screens; the long-handled picker held at a stable slight 3/4 or clean 90-degree side angle and the same scale with the shaft perfectly straight; infographic components of thin single-weight circular icon nodes, dotted leader lines ending in a solid dot, dashed-circle step wells, arch-shaped cards and rounded rectangles with 24px corner radius; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no cartoon mascot drift, no gross-out imagery.
noDrift: no cartoon mascot or 3D illustration drift
no gross-out imagery, faeces detail or insect marks
no bent, warped or elongated shaft
style.presentationRules: the long-handled picker is held at the same slight 3/4 or clean 90-degree side angle and the same scale on every screen, shaft rendered perfectly straight with no bending, jaws closed in packshots and open only in mechanism, working and step screens, product always grounded by a contact shadow, one domestic dog cropped above the shoulders or at the muzzle so no individual animal identity reads, no graphic waste ever depicted
